Title: Elder Intervention & Pack Tactics ARE THE SAME CARD

Messages.Author: mirddes
Messages.Body:
WHY DOES PACK TACTICS EXIST?

Elder Intervention
[Reaction] Reaction

[1 Blood]

Do not replace until after this action.
Only usable during a bleed against you. This vampire gets +2 intercept. A vampire cannot play both Pack Tactics and Elder Intervention in the same action.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> elotar wrote:
> The logic was theme of the set, somebody desided that you can't have "elder"/"ancilla" cards in sabbat set.
>
Most likely that, and the fact that Sabbat was intended to be playable as a standalone set / base set. (The word "stand-alone" appears on the booster wrappers.) Note that Elder Intervention had been added in V:TES - it wasn't in Jyhad - as one of the tools to let you withstand stealth-bleed, along with Protected Resources, Archon Investigation, and Justicar Retribution. Presumably it was felt that the effect of Elder Intervention was something the Sabbat needed, but wanted something more thematic for the Sabbat.

Along similar lines, Meat Cleaver turns up in Sabbat, but is the same card as Bastard Sword - same cost, same effect. It doesn't need a specific non-stacking clause like Elder Intervention has, because weapons don't stack in the same way that reactions can (e.g. you can only use one weapon per strike, even if you have 10 Bastard Swords equipped). However, a Meat Cleaver probably seems more in-theme for a more brutal, gruesome sect like the Sabbat.
